title: Brand Link H3
description: H3 heading styled as a Brand link. Default text is contrast, hover and active states change to Brand cyan.

styles.css: &{transition: color 200ms ease;} & a{transition: color 200ms ease;} & a:hover{color: var(--wp--preset--color--brand-500); text-decoration: none;} & a:active{color: var(--wp--preset--color--brand-500); text-decoration: none;} & a:focus-visible{color: var(--wp--preset--color--brand-500); outline: 2px solid var(--wp--preset--color--focus-background); outline-offset: 2px;}
